archetypes.name: expected-total-trace
archetypes.rationale: The whole value of these tests is that the asserted totals match what the dedupe logic actually produces.
archetypes.prompt_body: Verify each asserted total by hand-tracing _split_shard_attempts and shard_totals_per_run against the row sequences in the three new tests. Confirm the retried-shard total is 20.0 (latest attempt [a12,b8]), the multi-bash total is 10.0 (single attempt sums all four rows), and the combined total is 15.0 (latest attempt [a4,a5,b6]). Confirm the stated regression sentinels (35.0, 7.0, 21.0) are exactly what a dedupe or branch-order regression would yield, so the assertions are not tautological. Confirm exact float equality is safe for these integer-valued operands. Cite specific file:line references in python/harness_ci_timing.py and python/test_harness_ci_timing.py for every claim. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: regression-guard-and-style
archetypes.rationale: Tests must fail under the targeted regressions and match existing conventions without adding helpers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Confirm the three new tests are real regression guards: each must fail if latest-attempt selection is removed or if the consecutive-repeat and first-target branches in _split_shard_attempts are swapped. Confirm placement under the existing shard_totals_per_run section, snake_case naming consistent with test_shard_totals_per_run_basic, and bind-then-assert style matching the existing test. Confirm no new helpers, fixtures, imports, or production-code changes are introduced, per the approved non-goals. Cite specific file:line references in python/test_harness_ci_timing.py for every claim. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
